The framework is60+60+60EC, with12EC selected neutrally from four restricted options and30EC genuine free space. Internship6/12/18EC, full first-year completion, approval/non-overlap, language testing,42ECstudy advice, capacity and assessment/attendance conditions are kept explicit. No mixed-cohort closure or invented waiver is used.

Rechecked the exact12generator,18support and11search-only rows against programme, year, careers and experience material. The strongest challenge is that a coherent environmental science or commercial-business programme would not answer a degree about public problems, policy and institutions. Five science/engineering and three commercial replacements give the climate and organisations routes sustained public, social and empirical substance. The strongest closest response includes actual public economics, constitutional law, EU policy research, civil society and organisational psychology, with quantitative and qualitative inquiry. Dedicated Dutch administration and policy-implementation sequences remain material gaps. Housing/poverty does not produce a new label for generic governance: the available catalogue lacks sustained specific housing-policy study, and Public Policy Analysis is unavailable in the planned semesters.

academicReview: Three evidence-backed related routes respond to the defining public problem, policy, institution and organisational substance. General coherence or environmental/business labels alone do not establish comparability under the CP119 distinction. Five science/engineering placements in the climate route and three generic business placements in the organisations route are replaced with stronger public, social and empirical study. Housing and poverty remain evidenced public problems; the separate candidate lacks a sustained available housing-policy sequence beyond general economics and sociology, so it is not included under a new label. Public Policy Analysis exists in the workbook but is unavailable in the planned semesters and cannot fill that gap. The maximum of three is reached only after these substantive tests.
